notes: Canonical migration preserves all 25 legacy dispatch owners and adds reviewed controller policies 0x4d4240, 0x4d45f0 and 0x4d46f0. Legacy PaletteResourceRuntime source, header and app API remain unchanged. MFC containers, CString, resource loading and diagnostic reporter execute as original callees.
